title: A complete Yb laser system: oscillator, stretcher, amplifier, compressor
summary: A SESAM mode-locked Yb:YAG oscillator (1.08 W, 871 fs) feeds a grating stretcher, an 8-pass Yb:YAG amplifier at 10 kHz and a compressor, and the system delivers 198 µJ in 1.08 ps, at the transform limit of the amplified spectrum.
